title: How bridging works
lead: Deposit to Fuel Ignition or withdraw back to Ethereum. Connect both wallets, choose an asset and confirm.
withdraw_note: Withdrawals to Ethereum take up to {{delay}}

connect.title: Connect both wallets
connect.description: Connect a Fuel wallet and an Ethereum wallet. The bridge shows both addresses before you send.

amount.title: Choose an asset and amount
amount.description: Pick the asset and enter an amount. MAX fills your full balance.

confirm.title: Confirm and track
confirm.description: Sign the transaction in your wallet. Every transfer appears in History until it settles.

duration.question: How long does a withdrawal take?
duration.answer: Assets deposited to Fuel can take up to {{delay}} to withdraw back to Ethereum. The docs explain the architecture and security behind that window.

assets.question: Which assets can I bridge?
assets.answer: The asset selector lists every supported asset. ETH is selected by default.

faster.question: Is there a faster route?
faster.answer: Partner bridges, like the one in the banner above the form, offer fast bridging to Fuel Ignition.

history.question: Where do I see past transfers?
history.answer: Open History at the top of the bridge panel. Pending and completed transfers are listed there.

cancel.question: Can I cancel a transfer?
cancel.answer: No. A transfer cannot be reversed once you sign it, so check both addresses first.
